parole.significato: Any of various flatworms of the order Tricladida living in marine, freshwater, or terrestrial environments.
parole.testo: From translingual Planaria (genus) (from Late Latin plānārius (“lying on a plane”), from Latin plānum) + -an.
From the translingual Termes (genus name), from Late Latin termes, late variant of Classical Latin tarmes (“woodworm”).
